items.description: Add radio button toggle between 'Single view' and 'Grid view' in the main interface. The toggle should match the existing UI style and be positioned prominently above the canvas area.
stepsToVerify: Radio buttons are visible above the canvas area
Toggle styling matches existing UI components (using shadcn/ui RadioGroup)
Single view is selected by default
Clicking Grid view switches the view mode
Clicking Single view returns to the original canvas display
Toggle state persists during parameter changes

items.description: When 'Grid view' is selected, replace the single canvas with a grid layout displaying 20 smaller SVG previews. Each SVG should be rendered at a consistent preview size (e.g., 200x200px) regardless of the configured canvas size. SVG previews should preserve aspect ratio (letterbox if needed). Hovering over a grid item should show a tooltip displaying the exact parameter value used for that variation.
stepsToVerify: Grid displays exactly 20 SVG previews when Grid view is active
SVGs are arranged in a responsive grid layout (e.g., 4x5 or 5x4)
Each SVG preview has consistent dimensions
SVG aspect ratio is preserved (letterboxed, not stretched)
Hovering a grid item shows tooltip with the varied parameter's exact value
Grid is scrollable if it exceeds viewport height
Single canvas is hidden when Grid view is active
Grid view area occupies the same space as the single canvas

items.description: Each of the 20 SVGs in the grid should be generated with the same base configuration, but with one parameter varying across a range. The varying parameter's value should be calculated based on the SVG's index (0-19), distributed evenly across the parameter's valid range. For parameters with limited discrete values (e.g., integers 1-5), repeat values as needed to fill 20 slots rather than interpolating invalid values.
stepsToVerify: All 20 SVGs share the same base configuration except the varying parameter
The varying parameter values are distributed evenly from min to max
Index 0 uses the minimum value, index 19 uses the maximum value
Integer parameters only use valid integer values (repeating if range is smaller than 20)
SVGs visually differ from each other when the varying parameter affects appearance
Changing base configuration updates all 20 SVGs in real-time

items.description: Add a row of toggle buttons above the grid to select which parameter varies across the SVGs. Default selection is 'frequency'. Eligible parameters: density, fill amount, gamma, frequency, contrast, directional neighbors, direction density. Excluded: canvas size, colors, cell scale, fill type.
stepsToVerify: Toggle row is visible above the grid in Grid view mode
Toggle row is hidden in Single view mode
Exactly 7 parameter options are available (density, fill amount, gamma, frequency, contrast, directional neighbors, direction density)
Frequency is selected by default
Only one parameter can be selected at a time
Selecting a different parameter regenerates all 20 SVGs with the new varying parameter
Toggle styling matches existing UI components

items.category: UI - Settings Panel in Grid View
items.description: The settings panel on the right side must remain visible and functional when Grid view is active. Changes to settings should update all 20 SVGs in the grid in real-time.
stepsToVerify: Settings panel is visible in Grid view
All existing settings controls remain functional
Changing any setting updates all 20 grid SVGs immediately
The varying parameter's slider shows the base value (not the varied values)
Panel collapse/expand functionality works in Grid view

items.description: Add an 'Export settings as JSON' button below the existing action buttons (Randomize, Export SVG, Copy SVG). When clicked, downloads a JSON file containing the current configuration settings that can be used with the website's generateFragmentSvg function.
stepsToVerify: Button is visible below existing action buttons
Button styling matches existing action buttons
Clicking the button triggers a file download
Downloaded file is valid JSON

JSON contains all relevant parameters: threshold, gamma, frequency, contrast, seed, directionalNeighbors, directionDensity, fillAmount, fillType, invertFill, foregroundColor, backgroundColor, cellSize
JSON includes metadata: version, exportedAt timestamp
JSON includes optional seedParam field (defaults to 'frequency')

items.description: Extract SVG generation logic into a separate, self-contained module that can be easily copied to the website repository. The module should export a function that accepts a seed string, configuration object, and returns an SVG string. Use the djb2 hash algorithm for converting seed strings to numeric values - this ensures deterministic results that match between this tool and the website.
stepsToVerify: SVG generation logic is in a separate file (e.g., src/lib/generateFragmentSvg.ts)
Module has no dependencies on React or UI components
Module exports a pure function: generateFragmentSvg(seedString: string, config: FragmentConfig) => string
Module includes djb2 hash function implementation
Function uses djb2 hash of seed string to deterministically set the seeded parameter
Function produces identical output for identical inputs
Existing AssetGenerator.tsx imports and uses this module
Module includes TypeScript types for configuration object

items.description: Create a utility function that generates an array of 20 configurations, each with the varying parameter adjusted based on index. This supports both the Grid view feature and potential batch generation use cases. For parameters with limited discrete values, the function should distribute available values across slots (repeating if necessary).
stepsToVerify: Utility function exists and is exported
Function signature: generateGridVariations(baseConfig, varyingParam, count) => config[]
Returns array of exactly 'count' configurations
Each configuration has the varying parameter set to an evenly distributed value
Integer parameters use only valid integer values
Non-varying parameters are unchanged from baseConfig
Function handles all 7 eligible varying parameters correctly

items.description: Grid view should render smoothly without noticeable lag. Implement appropriate performance optimizations (e.g., memoization, debouncing rapid setting changes) to ensure responsive interaction.
stepsToVerify: Initial grid render completes without perceptible delay
Changing the varying parameter updates grid responsively
Changing a base setting updates grid responsively
No visible flickering during updates
Browser remains responsive during grid operations

items.description: Ensure that SVGs generated in Single view, Grid view, and via the modular function are visually identical when given the same parameters. Minor formatting differences in SVG output (whitespace, attribute order) are acceptable as long as rendered appearance is identical.
stepsToVerify: Generate SVG in Single view with specific settings
View same settings in Grid view - the SVG at the matching variation point should look visually identical
Call generateFragmentSvg with same settings - rendered output should be visually identical
djb2 hash produces consistent results across all generation methods

items.description: The Single/Grid view toggle must use the segmented pill control pattern already established in the UI (matching Canvas Size 1K|2K|4K and Zoom 25%|50%|100% controls), not radio buttons. Selected state: bg-white/20 border-2 border-white/40 text-white. Unselected state: bg-black/30 border border-white/20 text-white/60. Placement: Centered above the canvas area.
stepsToVerify: Toggle uses segmented pill pattern, not radio buttons
Visual styling matches existing 1K/2K/4K controls exactly
Hover state: hover:text-white hover:bg-black/40
Keyboard navigable with arrow keys

items.description: The parameter variation selector above the grid should use wrapping chips/pills that flow onto multiple lines if needed (flex flex-wrap gap-2). All 7 options must be visible without scrolling. Selected state matches other toggles: bg-white/20 border-2 border-white/40. Default selection: 'Frequency'. Chip labels: 'Density', 'Fill %', 'Gamma', 'Frequency', 'Contrast', 'Dir. Neighbors', 'Dir. Density'.
stepsToVerify: All 7 parameter chips visible without horizontal scroll
Chips wrap to 2 rows if viewport is narrow
Selected chip is visually distinct
Only one chip selected at a time
12px gap between chips

items.description: One grid item should be visually highlighted to indicate 'this matches your current base config value.' Styling: ring-2 ring-white/60 or border-2 border-white/50. If current value falls between two grid items, highlight the nearest match.
stepsToVerify: One grid item is visually distinct from others
Highlighted item updates when base config changes
Highlight is visible but not distracting
Works correctly for all 7 variable parameters

items.description: Grid items need hover feedback and tooltips showing the exact parameter value. Hover state: subtle border emphasis (border-white/40), optional scale-[1.02] with transition-transform duration-150. Tooltip styling: bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/20 text-white text-sm rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5. Shows 'Frequency: 0.23' format. 200ms delay before showing. Touch devices: long-press (500ms) triggers tooltip.
stepsToVerify: Hover triggers visual feedback
Tooltip appears with correct value after 200ms delay
Tooltip positioned without viewport clipping
Touch interaction works on mobile (long-press)
Cursor is cursor-default (view-only)

items.description: The 'Export Settings as JSON' button should match the 'Reset to Default Settings' button pattern - full width with icon + text. Styling: w-full bg-black/30 hover:bg-white/10 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/20 text-white/70 hover:text-white py-3 px-4 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center gap-2. Icon: FileJson or Braces (w-4 h-4). Placement: Below the Reset button with 12px gap.
stepsToVerify: Button matches Reset button styling exactly
Full width within the panel
Icon + text visible
Download triggers correctly

items.description: Define exact breakpoints and minimum sizes for the grid. Default: 5 columns × 4 rows (20 items). Narrow viewport (<1200px with panel open): 4 columns × 5 rows. Minimum item size: 120px × 120px. Gap: 12px. Grid items are always square containers. Non-square SVGs are centered within the square, letterboxed with background color. Never stretch or crop.
stepsToVerify: Grid renders 20 items in 5×4 layout on wide screens
Grid collapses to 4×5 on narrow screens
Items never shrink below 120px
Non-square canvases letterbox correctly
Grid scrolls vertically if needed

items.description: Specify loading states while 20 SVGs are generating. Show skeleton placeholders immediately (20 gray squares with subtle pulse animation). Render SVGs progressively as they complete. Use useDeferredValue or similar to prevent blocking UI. Debounce settings changes by 100ms before regenerating grid.
stepsToVerify: Skeleton appears immediately when switching to Grid view
SVGs populate progressively
Settings changes debounce correctly (100ms)
No UI jank during generation

notes: The modular generateFragmentSvg function is the key deliverable for website integration
Grid view serves as a preview tool to verify how SVGs will look with different seed values
JSON export format should match the expected input format for the website function
Excluded parameters (canvas size, colors, cell scale, fill type) from variation because they affect structural appearance rather than pattern variation
djb2 hash algorithm chosen for its simplicity and portability - easy to implement identically on website
Grid is view-only (no click-to-apply interaction), but tooltips show exact parameter values on hover
Design direction: Precision & Density - dark mode, subtle borders, technical tool aesthetic
Use Lucide icons: LayoutGrid for Grid view, Square for Single view, FileJson or Braces for Export JSON
Keep all UI elements monochrome (white/gray on dark) consistent with existing design
